responsibility: Implements the lightweight Tree SSA pass that eliminates degenerate PHI nodes and the trivial copy or constant-propagation opportunities they create, primarily after CFG rewrites such as jump threading. It walks the dominator tree to replace PHI results or single-value assignments with their unique incoming SSA name or constant, propagates those replacements through immediate uses, tracks newly exposed PHIs/statements on a bitmap worklist for second-order cleanup, and handles side effects of the rewrite such as EH-edge cleanup, CFG simplification requests, dominance invalidation, and SSA updates; unlike the general CCP or copy-propagation passes, this file is a fast specialized cleaner focused on PHI-originated propagation only.
